prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Charles MO for a rental home?
engine_stated_criteria: Keyrenter St. Charles is a strong first company to interview
answer_verbatim:
**Keyrenter St. Charles is a strong first company to interview** for a single-family rental home. It focuses on residential rentals, has a local St. Charles office, and advertises leasing, rent collection, maintenance coordination, and 24/7 emergency response. Its published pricing starts at **10% monthly management for one property**, plus a **$695–$895 leasing fee**; confirm the full fee schedule and contract terms directly.

I’d also get a quote from **Real Property Management Three Bridges** and **Alpha Real Estate Group** before deciding. RPM Three Bridges serves St. Charles County and advertises end-to-end management and around-the-clock support; Alpha is a local firm with more than 25 years’ experience and offers inspections, tenant screening, leasing, maintenance, and financial reporting.

There isn’t enough independent, comparable evidence here to call one company definitively “the best.” Compare written proposals on total fees, maintenance markups and approval limits, inspection frequency, lease-renewal charges, eviction handling, and how quickly they respond to owners. Ask for references from owners with similar homes.
